articles.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 is now so far away that light takes 24 hours to reach it
articles.summary: NASA’s Voyager 1 has reached an extraordinary milestone, traveling 16.1 billion miles from Earth to become the first spacecraft so distant that its signals take a full day to reach us. Nearly 50 years after launch, the aging probe continues its historic journey through interstellar space, pushing the limits of human exploration despite dwindling power and technical challenges.

articles.title: After 8 years in space, a groundbreaking X-ray telescope finally opens its eyes
articles.summary: After eight years and 10 billion kilometers in space, a groundbreaking X-ray telescope heading to Mercury has captured its first cosmic observations and is performing even better than scientists expected. The instrument could soon reveal Mercury's hidden chemical secrets and transform our understanding of how the solar system's smallest planet formed.

articles.title: The call of the seamount: Two new armored tardigrades described in the Atlantic
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: An international team led by researchers from Senckenberg am Meer in Wilhelmshaven has described two new species of marine tardigrades. The tiny marine organisms were discovered in the sediment of the Senghor Seamount off the coast of Cape Verde. According to the researchers, the discovery underscores the role of undersea mountains as oases of biodiversity. The study, which includes comprehensive taxonomic descriptions of the new species, has been published in the journal "ZooKeys."
